city.name: Philadelphia
city.regionLabel: Philadelphia, nearby suburbs and a sensible drive

events.title: PECO Free First Sunday Family Day: Thriving Traditions at the Barnes
events.description: Free gallery access plus art activities, scavenger hunts, storytime at 10:30 AM, and Native Nations Dance Theater performances at 1 PM and 2:30 PM for Indigenous Peoples' Day. Registration is required and capacity is limited.

events.title: Van Gogh's Sunflowers at the Philadelphia Museum of Art
events.priceLabel: Free with museum admission (check source for price)
events.description: Two of Van Gogh's Sunflowers paintings, one from London's National Gallery and one from the PMA collection, hang side by side in Colket Gallery 251 through October 11. The show is included with museum admission.

events.title: Autumn's Colors and Illuminated Fountain Performances at Longwood Gardens
events.description: Autumn's Colors runs October 2 to November 15 with harvest displays, a garden railway, daytime fountain shows at 10:15, 12:15, 2:15 and 4:15, and illuminated fountain performances in the evening. Gardens are open until 9 PM Friday through Sunday.

events.title: Autumn's Colors and Illuminated Fountain Performances at Longwood Gardens
events.description: Autumn's Colors runs October 2 to November 15 with harvest displays, a garden railway, daytime fountain shows at 10:15, 12:15, 2:15 and 4:15, and illuminated fountain performances in the evening. Gardens are open until 9 PM Friday through Sunday.

events.title: Reading Liederkranz Oktoberfest
events.description: A longtime Oktoberfest with Dave Kline & Bavarski, tuba and waltz competitions, schuhplattlers and a beer-tapping parade on Saturday. Sunday is Family Day with the Garrett Tatano Band, a magician and a bounce house.

events.title: Reading Liederkranz Oktoberfest
events.description: A longtime Oktoberfest with Dave Kline & Bavarski, tuba and waltz competitions, schuhplattlers and a beer-tapping parade on Saturday. Sunday is Family Day with the Garrett Tatano Band, a magician and a bounce house.

events.title: The Philadelphia Orchestra: Yannick Conducts Mahler's Symphony No. 5
events.description: Yannick Nézet-Séguin conducts Mahler's Fifth, with its famous Adagietto, alongside Webern's Im Sommerwind and Julia Wolfe's new Liberty Bell; about two hours with intermission.

events.title: Philadelphia Eagles vs. Los Angeles Rams
events.address: 1 Lincoln Financial Field Way, Philadelphia, PA 19148
events.description: Week 4 home game against the Rams on FOX; Eagles are 3-0 against LA over the past two seasons. Open Streets West Walnut also shows the game live.

events.title: Evil Genius 15th Anniversary Block Party with Wheatus
events.address: Front St and Palmer Ave, Philadelphia, PA 19122
events.description: Evil Genius Beer celebrates 15 years with a street festival on Front Street: eight bands from noon, including Tell All Your Friends and Lunar Pools, and a Wheatus headline set from 8 to 10 PM. Vendors and neighborhood food and drink on site.

events.title: Fells Point Fun Festival (60th annual)
events.address: Thames St from Caroline St to Wolfe St, Baltimore, MD 21231
events.description: Baltimore's 60th annual harborfront street festival: six blocks of live music, 225+ food and craft vendors, a Maryland beer, wine and spirits park, a family fun park and a Sunday pet parade.

events.title: Fleurs de Villes: The Gilded Age at Lynnewood Hall
events.description: A floral exhibition inside the Gilded Age mansion Lynnewood Hall, open to the public for the first time in decades. Last entry is 5 PM, and the run ends Sunday, October 4.

events.title: Pumpkinland at Linvilla Orchards
events.time: 8:00 AM – 9:00 PM Sat; 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM Sun
events.priceLabel: Free entry; mazes from $7, hayrides from $9
events.description: Free-to-walk fall festival with giant scarecrows, hayrides, straw bale and corn mazes, train and pony rides, and apple blasters. Individual activities are ticketed separately.

events.title: Pumpkinland at Linvilla Orchards

events.title: Experience the Unexpected: Wand and Potion Making at Morris Arboretum
events.description: Visitors make magical wands and potions from natural materials, free with general admission, alongside the Pumpkin Cottage and the 19th annual Scarecrow Walk running October 1 to November 1.

events.title: Bordentown Cranberry Festival
events.venue: Farnsworth Avenue (Burlington St to Park St)
events.description: The 36th annual juried arts and crafts festival fills downtown Farnsworth Avenue both days with more than 100 artists and crafters, plus live music and food.

events.title: Scarecrows in the Village at Peddler's Village
events.address: Route 202 and Street Rd, Lahaska, PA 18931
events.description: Now in its 47th year, over 100 scarecrows line the brick pathways of Peddler's Village daily through October 26, alongside seasonal shops and restaurants.

events.title: Scarecrows in the Village at Peddler's Village

events.description: Now in its 47th year, over 100 scarecrows line the brick pathways of Peddler's Village daily through October 26, alongside seasonal shops and restaurants.

events.title: Clover Market in Bryn Mawr
events.venue: Downtown Bryn Mawr (N Bryn Mawr Ave and Lancaster Ave)
events.address: 7 N Bryn Mawr Ave, Bryn Mawr, PA 19010
events.description: About 90 curated vintage and handmade vendors, food trucks, live music by Matt Kresge from noon to 3 PM, and free kids' crafts, steps from the Bryn Mawr SEPTA station.

events.title: Horsegirl & Cowdaddy at the Wilma Theater
events.time: 7:00 PM (Open Caption and Black Affinity Night)
events.description: A 1 hour 45 minute play in its final weekend, running through October 4. The Wilma lists content warnings for simulated sex acts, partial nudity, kink, strobing lights, loud sounds and haze.

events.title: Horsegirl & Cowdaddy at the Wilma Theater
events.description: A 1 hour 45 minute play in its final weekend, running through October 4. The Wilma lists content warnings for simulated sex acts, partial nudity, kink, strobing lights, loud sounds and haze.

events.title: Ancient Egypt in Watercolors at the Penn Museum
events.description: Century-old watercolors of Egyptian tombs never before shown in the United States are on view while the Ancient Egypt and Nubia galleries are renovated (reopening December 12, 2026). Open Tuesday through Sunday.

events.title: Noguchi to Asawa: Designing Postwar America at the Barnes
events.description: The Barnes presents Noguchi to Asawa through January 10, 2027, alongside Sky Hopinka: Red Metal Dust and Just Us (through October 12). Open Thursday through Monday, 11 AM to 5 PM; Sunday October 4 is Free First Sunday with registration.

events.title: Spooky Mini Golf at Franklin Square
events.description: Philly Mini Golf puts on its Halloween costume, with a course of famous Philadelphia landmarks decorated for the season. Open daily through October.

events.title: Spooky Mini Golf at Franklin Square
events.description: Philly Mini Golf puts on its Halloween costume, with a course of famous Philadelphia landmarks decorated for the season. Open daily through October.

events.title: Reading Terminal Market
events.description: The historic public market is open daily 8 AM to 6 PM, so both weekend days work for lunch and browsing. Its fall events, the Scrapple & Apple Festival on October 17 and others, come later in the month.

events.title: Chestnut Hill Night of Lights
events.description: Six projected video exhibitions light up storefront windows along Germantown Avenue, telling 250 years of Northwest Philadelphia history, with live music and storytellers at the sites. Hosted by the Chestnut Hill Conservancy.

events.title: Chestnut Hill Night of Lights
events.description: Six projected video exhibitions light up storefront windows along Germantown Avenue, telling 250 years of Northwest Philadelphia history, with live music and storytellers at the sites. Hosted by the Chestnut Hill Conservancy.

events.title: Brew N' History Tour at Christ Church Burial Ground
events.description: A guided walk past the graves of Benjamin Franklin and Declaration signers, with five stops pairing local craft beer samples with stories of colonial tavern culture.

events.title: Brew N' History Tour at Christ Church Burial Ground
events.description: A guided walk past the graves of Benjamin Franklin and Declaration signers, with five stops pairing local craft beer samples with stories of colonial tavern culture.

events.title: Pumpkin Patch Flyer train ride
events.venue: Woodstown Central Railroad, South Woodstown Station
events.description: An 18-mile vintage train ride through Salem County to Fenwick Grove, with about 45 minutes in the pumpkin patch and one pumpkin to take home. The full trip runs about 1 hour 45 minutes.

events.title: Philadelphia Zoo and Boo at the Zoo
events.description: The zoo is open daily 9:30 AM to 5 PM (last entry 4 PM), and its Halloween event Boo at the Zoo is included with general admission, with trick-or-treating for costumed kids.

events.title: Open Streets: West Walnut
events.venue: Walnut St (Broad to 19th) and 18th St (Chestnut to Locust)
events.address: Walnut St between Broad St and 19th St, Philadelphia, PA 19103
events.description: Nearly eight car-free blocks of Walnut Street with live music, bubble artists, a kids' zone, mini golf and live Eagles game broadcasts at the Fulton Fun Zone.

events.title: Headhouse Farmers Market
events.description: The Food Trust's year-round Sunday market under the historic Head House shambles, with regional farmers, bakers and prepared-food vendors.

events.title: Giargiari Bel Canto Competition
events.address: 300 S Broad St (Perelman Theater, Kimmel Center), Philadelphia, PA 19102
events.description: The Academy of Vocal Arts' resident opera singers compete in demanding bel canto arias before judges and an audience that votes for the Audience Choice Award.

events.title: The Fillmore Philadelphia: Switchfoot with Anberlin (Forever Now Tour)
events.description: Alt-rock band Switchfoot headlines with special guest Anberlin at the Fishtown venue as part of the Forever Now Tour.

events.title: The Fillmore Philadelphia: Rise Against with Alkaline Trio (Ricochet 2026)
events.description: Punk veterans Rise Against play the Fishtown venue on the Ricochet 2026 tour, with Alkaline Trio and Teen Mortgage in support.

events.title: Hershey Bears Home Opener vs. Charlotte Checkers (Opening Night)
events.description: The 13-time Calder Cup champion Bears open their AHL home season with a Saturday opening night magnet-schedule giveaway and a Sunday Dark Nights Takeover with Hersheypark Halloween characters.

events.title: Hershey Bears Home Opener vs. Charlotte Checkers (Opening Night)
events.description: The 13-time Calder Cup champion Bears open their AHL home season with a Saturday opening night magnet-schedule giveaway and a Sunday Dark Nights Takeover with Hersheypark Halloween characters.

events.title: Jim Thorpe Fall Foliage Festival
events.address: Broadway & Race St, Jim Thorpe, PA 18229
events.description: Craft and food vendors, free live music at four locations, and scenic Lehigh Gorge train excursions in the Switzerland of America; the first of three October foliage weekends.

events.title: Geoffrey Asmus at Helium Comedy Club
events.description: Stand-up Geoffrey Asmus, who has opened for Dave Attell and Mark Normand, headlines a weekend run at Helium with an opener and a feature; two-item minimum in the showroom.

events.title: Geoffrey Asmus at Helium Comedy Club
events.description: Stand-up Geoffrey Asmus, who has opened for Dave Attell and Mark Normand, headlines a weekend run at Helium with an opener and a feature; two-item minimum in the showroom.

events.title: Plastic Cup Boyz at Punch Line Philly
events.description: The Plastic Cup Boyz comedy troupe plays two Saturday shows and one Sunday show at Fishtown's Punch Line comedy club.

events.title: Plastic Cup Boyz at Punch Line Philly
events.description: The Plastic Cup Boyz comedy troupe plays two Saturday shows and one Sunday show at Fishtown's Punch Line comedy club.

events.title: The Franklin Institute: Science Museum, Planetarium and Body Odyssey
events.description: Open daily 9:30 AM–5 PM with three floors of hands-on exhibits, live science shows, Fels Planetarium and the Giant Heart in the new Body Odyssey exhibit. Special exhibits cost extra.

events.title: Mütter Museum of The College of Physicians of Philadelphia
events.description: The renowned medical-history museum of anatomical specimens, medical instruments and curiosities is open Sunday 10 AM–5 PM. Capacity is limited to 50 guests per half hour, so pre-booking is recommended.

events.title: National Constitution Center: America's Founding and Pennsylvania's Founding
events.description: Interactive galleries on the Constitution plus the new special exhibit Pennsylvania's Founding, open September 30, 2026 through January 3, 2027. Open Wednesday through Sunday, 10 AM–5 PM.

events.title: Philadelphia's Magic Gardens: Mosaic Art Environment
events.description: Isaiah Zagar's immersive mosaic labyrinth of tile, bottles and folk art covering indoor galleries and an outdoor garden. Open Wednesday through Monday, 11 AM–6 PM.

events.title: Eastern State Penitentiary: Daytime Tours
events.description: Explore the historic prison on a self-guided audio tour (about 40 minutes) or a 45-minute guide-led tour, with art installations and mini-tours included. Open daily 10 AM–5 PM.

events.title: Independence Seaport Museum: USS Olympia and Submarine Becuna
events.description: Board the USS Olympia, the oldest steel warship afloat, and tour the WWII submarine Becuna on the Delaware waterfront. Open Thursday through Tuesday 10 AM–5 PM.

events.title: Elmwood Park Zoo Harvest Fest and Boo at the Zoo
events.time: 10:00 AM–4:00 PM (Boo at the Zoo 10:30 AM–3:30 PM)
events.description: Zoo-wide fall celebration with carnival games, carousel rides and live music, plus the annual Halloween Boo at the Zoo for little ghouls and ghosts. Zoo open 10 AM–5 PM.

events.title: Everything Everything: Get To Heaven 10th Anniversary Tour
events.description: UK art-rock band Everything Everything plays its Get To Heaven 10th anniversary tour, with support from Psymon Spine. Tickets through Ticketmaster; VIP upgrades offered.

events.title: Asha Banks: something inbetween tour
events.description: Singer Asha Banks brings her something inbetween tour to Brooklyn Bowl with support from Alfie Jukes. The venue listing flags tickets as almost gone.

events.title: Maggie Rose with Sadie Gust
events.description: Country and soul singer Maggie Rose headlines Ardmore Music Hall with Sadie Gust opening. Tickets are sold through Tixr.

events.title: The Little Mermen & The Princess Pals: Ultimate Disney Tribute Band
events.description: Rock & Roll Playhouse presents a Disney tribute band performing kid-friendly rock versions of favorite Disney songs at Ardmore Music Hall. Tickets through Tixr.

events.title: Franklin Mills Outdoor Flea Market
events.description: Outdoor flea market run by Phila Flea Markets at the Franklin Mills mall grounds on Sunday, October 4, 8 AM to 4 PM.
